name: CharacterEval
description: CharacterEval is a Chinese benchmark for evaluating Role-Playing Conversational Agents (RPCAs) with a dataset of 1,785 multi-turn dialogues featuring 77 characters from Chinese novels and scripts. It uses thirteen targeted metrics across four dimensions and includes CharacterRM, a role-playing reward model trained on human annotations to better correlate with human judgment.
reputation: A recent niche benchmark in the Chinese role-playing agent literature, mainly cited by researchers working on character-consistent dialogue evaluation.
notes: Dataset constructed with GPT-4 extraction and human quality control; includes character profiles from Baidu Baike; CharacterRM improves evaluation correlation.
